name: Cultist: Teachings of Mythrax lengthens Presence of N'Zoth's Tentacles by 25% (#1054)
contract: Teachings of Mythrax 561035 (Spell.dbc, family 31, passive) reads 'Increases the duration of Presence of N'Zoth and Presence of Y'Shaarj by $s1%.' ($s1 = 25). Its single effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER / SPELLMOD_DURATION with class mask word0 0x08000000, which no Presence stance carries (803037 and 803035 have family flags [0x4000, 0, 0x40]). The mask selects exactly the two durations the Presence tooltips quote: Eldritch Tentacle 500707 ('summon Tentacles on your back that attack a nearby enemy for $500707d', DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) and Presence of Y'Shaarj 807632 ('curse the ground for $807632d', 12000 ms). aura_ascension_cultist_event implements the N'Zoth proc by summoning creature 500464 with 500707's unmodified GetDuration(), so the talent never reached it. Expected: with the talent every Tentacle Presence of N'Zoth summons lives 8000 * 1.25 = 10000 ms. Eight fixture golems in two 20 sec ground effects (43429 and 17742, one-second ticks) give the proc many damage events; the first Tentacle is detected within one poll of its summon, Presence is then removed so no further Tentacle can be summoned, and the Tentacle must still exist 9.3 sec later (it would be gone after 8 sec before the fix) and be gone 10.7 sec later.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Teachings of Mythrax adds 25% to Eldritch Tentacle's 8 sec duration
SETUP: the first ground effect is burning the golems
SETUP: the second ground effect is burning the golems
Damage dealt summons a Tentacle through Presence of N'Zoth
Remove Presence so no later Tentacle can be summoned
DISCRIMINATING: the Tentacle is still there after 9.3 sec
The extended Tentacle is gone after 10.7 sec
